test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What does "expected years of schooling" measure?

options.text: The total number of years of schooling in a country.
The average number of years of schooling received by people ages 25 and older.
The number of years a child of school-entering age is expected to spend in school.
The projected past years of schooling.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The number of years a child of school-entering age is expected to spend in school.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Expected years of schooling** measures the total number of years a child, at the age of starting school, is expected to spend in education (primary through tertiary levels) under current enrollment rates.
 
• This metric is widely used in the **Human Development Index (HDI)** and serves as an indicator of the educational opportunities available in a country.
 
• It projects the schooling duration based on current patterns, assuming the child progresses through the educational system without repetition or dropout.
 
• The calculation includes the number of years in **primary, secondary, and tertiary education**, contributing to an estimate of future educational attainment.
 
• **UNESCO** and other global organizations often analyze this indicator to evaluate the quality and reach of education systems worldwide.
